caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with rounded corners, positioned in the center of the page. Approximately the left half of the tray is rendered in color, while the right half is sketched in pencil. The colored portion of the tray features a black background with a decorative border containing motifs of fruits, flowers, and leaves in shades of gold, green, red, and white. There is a small handle-like cutout at the top of the tray, bordered in white. The tray has a wide, ornate border, and the central area is largely solid black, suggesting a recessed section. The pencil-drawn section mirrors the design of the colored half, with floral and fruit patterns filling the border but without any color, only outlined details. The tray's composition is symmetrical, and the artwork is set against a plain, uncolored background. A small blue number "37" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Toleware Tray
